item.title: Ascension Parish hosts A Taste of Christmas event
item.description: GONZALES -&nbsp;Ascension Parish held its A Taste of Christmas event in Duplessis Park on Saturday.Families gathered to enjoy local vendors, live music and food trucks as they celebrated the holiday season.&nbsp;"I'm a big believer in supporting small and local. All 85 vendors are small and local businesses from Ascension to Livingston to Baton Rouge," said owner of Bearded Events Chad Brown.Children also had the opportunity to take pictures with Santa Claus.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: One injured after shooting near Gus Young Avenue
item.description: BATON ROUGE - The Baton Rouge Police Department responded to a shooting that left one man injured on Saturday near Gus Young Avenue.According to authorities, the shooting occurred around 4:30 p.m. near Ragusa's Deli, one man was injured after being struck in the foot.&nbsp;The victim of the shooting is in stable condition.Further details were not currently available.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Christmas in the Village continues with the Kiwanis Club Christmas Parade
item.description: LIVINGSTON - Christmas in the Village continued this week with the Kiwanis Club Christmas Parade.The parade rolled out on North Range Road Saturday afternoon in Denham Springs, with hundreds of people lining the streets to catch beads, candy and other treats.The parade featured cars, floats and dance troops all dressed in the theme of Glitter, Glow and Mistletoe.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Pedestrian struck by vehicle on North Foster Drive, in 'serious' condition
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; A pedestrian was taken to the hospital after being struck by a vehicle on North Foster Drive Saturday night, according to Baton Rouge EMS.&nbsp;The crash happened around 8:30 p.m. on North Foster Drive, near North Street.Officials said the person struck is in "serious" condition.Permalink| Comments
